architectureDecisions: D1 — Edit only packages/oracle/src/retrieval-planner.js reserve(). execute() budget checks stay on reservedBudget.

D2 — Drop Math.min(8192, remainingBytes). For READ_EXACT with N itemRefs on the evidence, each work gets items=1 and materializedBytes=Math.max(1, Math.floor(remainingBytes / remainingItemRefsFromThisEvidence)). For a single-itemRef evidence the one work therefore receives all remaining bytes. For TRAVERSE_GRAPH/FETCH_EXTERNAL, items=Math.max(1, remaining.maxItems-reserved.items) and materializedBytes=remainingBytes. For REPOSITORY without itemRefs, LOOKUP_SYMBOL and SEARCH_LEXICAL each keep items=1 so both still reserve; STRUCTURAL_MAP keeps items=1; each of those work units gets remainingBytes at reserve time divided by remaining operations still to reserve for that evidence.

D3 — RP1 in retrieval-planner.test.js: 9000-byte EXACT file, budget maxMaterializedBytes 40000, execute+facade COMPLETE with one candidate. This test fails on current main (BUDGET_EXHAUSTED). RP2: 9000-byte file with maxMaterializedBytes 100 stays UNSATISFIED BUDGET_EXHAUSTED and content is not truncated.
D4 — Keep execute() catch mapping: ProviderFailure.reason plus detail=error.message. Do not add code. Probe mappingKeys are evidenceId,providerId,reason,detail.

D5 — test/oracle-context-graph-boundary.test.mjs CG3 COMPLETE case currently asserts one path and truncated:true because items=1. After D2 TRAVERSE_GRAPH receives remaining maxItems (4 in that test), assert both importer paths and truncated false when both fit. packages/agentic-system/test/oracle-context-adoption.test.js comments about min(8192) stay valid as a lower bound if tests still pass; update comments if a 3*8192 comment would be false.
D6 — Living docs: docs/living/system/oracle/workflow.md and context-graph.md describe remaining-budget reservation, not a 8192-byte per-item cap. No Blackboard ids.
D7 — Evidence: planner-reservation-probe-result.json (9000-byte file, reserved 8192/1, facade UNSATISFIED BUDGET_EXHAUSTED).
implementationSlices: S1 — Reservation [RP1]: implement D2; RP1 fails on current main then passes.
S2 — Fail-closed oversize [RP2]: RP2 plus graph-boundary CG3 item-count update (D5).
